notes:
Summary: heavy-regulation gov agency looking for an air-gapped on-prem Redwood Private deployment. Wants full control plane in their datacenter or vendor-provided appliance; absolutely no outbound connections to internet from inference nodes. POC: 2-week air-gapped trial inside agency SOC w/ jump host. Requirements/asks: HSM/KMS integration (FIPS-140), STIG/CIS baseline, audit logging forwarded to offline Splunk ingest, seven-year retention for selected artifacts, SSO via SAML to their IdP, ability to run model quantized variants (cost control), deterministic rollbacks for any model changes. 

Call notes (shorthand):
- "cannot accept external outbound connections" (CTO repeated)
- SOC: wants show of install in their net before procurement; must see offline signing of binaries
- Legal: data residency + retention fine-print; asked for sample DPA + PSAs
- SE: asked for kernel/module whitelist and kernel lockdown notes (we promised a runbook)
- POC scope: inference-only (no telemetry out), control plane via air-gapped console image, HSM prototype integration with vendor HSM appliance.

Procurement: vendor must provide STIG-like checklist and attestations. Budget: internal estimate ~150-400k ARR depending on support SLAs and retention archive add-ons. Timeline: wants POC scheduled late-Apr/May; procurement Q3.

Open items: exact HSM vendor compatibility, SOC-ops shift schedule for POC window, final legal redlines on DPA. Next touch: AE to push arch questionnaire and propose 2-week POC dates; SE to prep air-gap runbook + demo image.
